about: Figures about the whole field from other publishers, traced to the original publication on 2026-11-26. Each is quoted with its scope.

items.title: A Look at 2026 Big Tech Shareholder Proposals
items.text: AI proposals at Alphabet, Amazon and Meta received 7.6% support on average in 2026, down from 9.8% in 2025 and 21.4% in 2024.
items.scope: Alphabet, Amazon and Meta only; Glass Lewis's own averages.

items.title: The Debriefing 2026: Season Review and Fall Engagement Guide
items.text: Total number of proposals filed in 2026 is down nearly 25% from 2025 and is at the lowest level we have seen over the past decade.
items.scope: All shareholder proposals, not only AI; Russell 3000, January to June 30, 2026 (page 5). The report prints no publication date.

items.publisher: Jill E. Fisch and Adriana Z. Robertson
items.title: Proxies for Politics (ECGI Law Working Paper 889/2025)
items.text: The authors find that the use of political-disclosure shareholder proposals over their study period, including proposals later withdrawn, is correlated with more political transparency by companies; they say they cannot demonstrate causation.
items.scope: Political-disclosure proposals, not AI proposals. This site's summary of the working paper's abstract.
